definitions.gloss: to pour into, to fill by pouring
definitions.explanation: To pour a liquid into a container or space.

definitions.gloss: to invest, to devote, to channel into
definitions.explanation: To put a large amount of money, time, effort, or emotion into something. Implies concentrated, intensive investment.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the literal meaning of pouring liquid. Sense 2 is figurative and very common, used for investing money, time, effort, or emotion into something.

FORMS:
⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧ (to pour) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix emphasizes the action going deeply into something.

- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む: to pour in funds
